---
title: "Correspondents"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(dplyr)
library(visNetwork)
library(readr)

# Load data
kimball <- read_csv(
  "data/kimball.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

# Count letters by author
author_counts <- kimball |> 
  filter(!is.na(author)) |> 
  count(author, sort = TRUE)

# Create author nodes
nodes <- author_counts |> 
  mutate(
    id = author,
    label = "",
    value = n,
    mass = n,
    title = paste0(
      "<b>", author, "</b><br>",
      "Letters sent: ", n
    ),
    shape = "dot"
  ) |> 
  select(id, label, value, mass, title, shape)

# Create connections from authors to Frederick J. Kimball
edges <- author_counts |> 
  mutate(
    from = author,
    to = "Frederick J. Kimball",
    value = n,
    title = paste0(n, " letters")
  ) |> 
  select(from, to, value, title)

# Add Frederick J. Kimball as central node
kimball_node <- data.frame(
  id = "Frederick J. Kimball",
  label = "Frederick J. Kimball",
  value = 20,
  mass = 5,
  title = "<b>Frederick J. Kimball</b><br>Central figure",
  shape = "star"
)

nodes <- bind_rows(nodes, kimball_node)

# Interactive network
visNetwork(nodes, edges) |> 
  visNodes(
    scaling = list(
      min = 5,
      max = 40
    ),
    font = list(
      size = 14
    )
  ) |> 
  visEdges(
    smooth = TRUE,
    color = list(
      opacity = 0.5
    )
  ) |> 
  visPhysics(
    solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
    forceAtlas2Based = list(
      gravitationalConstant = -80,
      centralGravity = 0.25,
      springLength = 120,
      springConstant = 0.05
    )
  ) |> 
  visOptions(
    highlightNearest = TRUE
  ) |> 
  visInteraction(
    hover = TRUE,
    navigationButtons = TRUE
  )
```
